name: css-is-awesome
description: A token-driven SCSS design system with light/dark theming, semantic color tokens, and a 800+ LOC mixin API.

scripts.build:min: sass scss/main.scss dist/css-is-awesome.min.css --style=compressed --no-source-map && sass scss/core.scss dist/css-is-awesome.core.min.css --style=compressed --no-source-map && sass scss/utilities-only.scss dist/css-is-awesome.utilities.min.css --style=compressed --no-source-map
scripts.build:all: npm run build && npm run build:core && npm run build:utilities && npm run build:min

author: Jerry2d3d
